title: The role of the mean curvature in nonlinear p-Laplacian problems with critical exponent
summary: We deal with critical nonlinear problems involving the p-Laplacian operator on bounded domains with mixed boundary conditions. We prove the existence of least energy solutions. Our work shows a significant difference between the semi-linear case p = 2 and the quasilinear case for the existence results. Moreover, neither the results for the Laplacian can be extended to the p-Laplacian, nor the method for the p-Laplacian can apply to the Laplacian setting.
